How to Prepare an Astro Diary for Self?
1) Dedicate a notebook or a diary for Astro analysis of Self
2) Draw the birth chart in the first page of the diary
3) Draw the planets table
4) Draw the houses table
5) Analyse the promise of each house in detail using the rule book. Write it down.
6) Analyse the current Mahadasa Lord (Star Lord + it's own signification)
7) Analyse the current Antardasa Lord (Bukthi Lord) (Star Lord signification first)
8) Daily, note down important events and the exact time/location
9) When time permits, draw a event (birth) chart for each event
10) Rotate the lagna in event chart to your birth lagna
11) Now, you will get the event transposed to your birth chart. Analyse. Why did the event take place at the time/date/location? Write it down.
12) If you do this for 30 days starting today, you will notice a significant pattern ruled by Moon.
13) If you do this for 365 days, understand Sun, Mercury, Venus rule over you.
14) If you do this for 12 years, understand Jupiter rule.
15) If you do this for 30 years, understand Saturn rule.
16) If you do this for 18-1/2 years, understand Rahu/Ketu rule
17) If you do this for 687 days, understand Mars rule
